newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rebels kill 38 troops in attack on camp.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rebels kill 38 troops in attack on camp.

text.p: Sri Lankan state radio said 38 security forces personnel were killed and 37 wounded when separatist Tamil Tiger guerrillas attacked a remote security camp in the island's east on Wednesday morning.

About 500 Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) guerrillas, who are fighting for independence in Sri Lanka's north and east, took part in the pre-dawn attack on the eastern Pulukunava camp, 200 kilometres (125 miles) from Colombo.
A large number of rebels were also killed when security forces counter-attacked, but rebel casualty figures were not immediately available, the radio said.
The rebels were not immediately available for comment.
